# Eagle 素材库\n\nEagle 插件把桌面 Eagle 资料库接入站点:
# Eagle asset library

The Eagle plugin connects the desktop Eagle library to the site's asset panel. The browser never accesses Eagle directly: all read, search, download and write requests go to the site backend first, and the backend then accesses the Eagle Local API address configured by the administrator.

## Before you start

1. Install and launch the Eagle desktop client, and open the library you want to use.
2. Confirm that the Eagle Local API is available; the default address is `{0}`.
3. Open the plugin settings as an administrator, enter the Base URL and load the folders.
4. After saving the configuration, choose the Eagle source in the asset library to browse and import assets.

> Eagle must stay running. If you close the client, switch libraries or change the local API port, the site will receive a connection failure, and this must not be masked with an empty list.

## Site backend endpoints

| Action | Site endpoint | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Read library | `GET /api/plugins/eagle/library?baseUrl=...` | Get the Eagle version, library name and folder tree |
| List assets | `GET /api/plugins/eagle/items` | Read assets by folder, keyword and page |
| Thumbnail | `GET /api/plugins/eagle/items/{id}/thumbnail` | Proxy the Eagle thumbnail |
| Original file | `GET /api/plugins/eagle/items/{id}/file` | Download and import into site resource storage |
| Write asset | `POST /api/plugins/eagle/items?baseUrl=...` | Write an image, video or audio back to Eagle |
| Create folder | `POST /api/plugins/eagle/folders?baseUrl=...` | Create a directory in Eagle |

These are internal site APIs that use the signed-in session and Cookie authentication; do not call them directly as if they were official Eagle APIs.

## Browse and search

The plugin reads the Eagle folder tree and builds full hierarchical paths. The asset list supports `folderId`, `keyword`, `limit` and `offset`. The folder list is cached within the current plugin instance; it is invalidated and reloaded after a folder is created. When you switch Eagle libraries, reopen the plugin settings to confirm the directories.

## Import into the site

On import, the backend proxies the download of the original Eagle file, and the frontend then writes it into the site's own image or media storage. Images keep their recognizable width, height and MIME; videos, audio and other model files keep the byte size, extension, Eagle item ID, folder and source metadata.

| Eagle content | Site result | Current limits |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Image | Image asset | Uses the original image; thumbnails are not treated as the finished file |
| Video | Video asset | When metadata lacks width and height, a 1280×720 display fallback is used and the original file is not rewritten |
| Audio | Audio asset | Duration is taken from the browser's media probe result |
| Other files | Model asset | Saved only as a file resource |
| Text / entities | Not supported | Import reports a clear error |

## Write back to Eagle

The plugin can convert site images, videos or audio into data URLs and then call Eagle to add the asset. An existing local Blob is read directly first; the remote generated URL is downloaded only when there is no local copy. By default a single manually uploaded file may not exceed 96 MB, and its MIME type must start with `image/`, `video/` or `audio/`.

After "Auto-upload generated results" is enabled, generated assets can be written to the configured target folder. An automatic write-back failure must be shown as a write-back failure, and "saved on the site" must not be misreported as "saved in Eagle".

## Configuration fields

| Field | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `baseUrl` | Eagle Local API address; only explicit HTTP(S) addresses are allowed | `{1}` |
| `autoUploadGenerated` | Whether to automatically write supported generated results back to Eagle | On |
| `generatedFolderId` | Target folder ID for automatic write-back | Empty, uses the Eagle default location |

## Security boundaries

- Eagle usually runs on the local machine. The backend must keep enforcing private-network target validation, allowing only local services explicitly configured by the administrator, and must not turn this proxy into an arbitrary URL fetcher.
- `baseUrl` stores only the service address, not a token, cookie or query key.
- Original files and data URLs must not enter logs, localStorage or error reports.
- In multi-user deployments, the server's `127.0.0.1` refers to the server itself, not the visitor's computer; use a client connection method that Eagle officially supports, and do not pretend a direct connection works.

## FAQ

| Symptom | What to check |
| --- | --- |
| Cannot read the library | Whether Eagle is running, the Base URL / port, and whether the backend can reach the host |
| Folders are empty | The library currently open in Eagle, filter conditions, folder hierarchy |
| Thumbnails show but import fails | Whether the original file still exists, file permissions, backend response status |
| Write-back fails | File size / MIME, whether the target folder exists, whether the remote generated link has expired |
| Deployed server cannot reach local Eagle | The network topology does not work; a local bridge is needed instead of changing the frontend URL |

- [Eagle API Documentation](https://api.eagle.cool/)
- [Eagle product and downloads](https://eagle.cool/)
# RunningHub 工作流\n\n该插件把 RunningHub 的 Wo:
# RunningHub workflow

This plugin connects RunningHub Workflow / App to canvas workflow nodes. The API Key, workflow parameters and field mappings are still saved and submitted securely by the host, and the plugin itself never touches the key.

In the plugin settings you can open the full RunningHub configuration page to pull workflows, edit field mappings and test requests.
# 媒体转换节点\n\n连接图片到转换节点后，可以在节点内选择灰度图、Canny:
# Media conversion node

After you connect an image to the conversion node, you can choose grayscale, Canny edges, AI line art, depth map or pose skeleton inside the node. AI line art uses the local ControlNet Aux preprocessing model, the depth map uses the locally installed Depth Anything V2 Small model, and the pose skeleton runs with the ControlNet Aux OpenPose human preprocessing model; none of these operations load a Stable Diffusion repaint pipeline. Pose conversion only draws the human skeleton, and is skipped with a notice when no person is detected. Video conversion and transparent cutout models are still being verified and will clearly report as unavailable for now.

This plugin only reads the media input of the current node and saves the result back to the local asset storage of the current canvas node.

【使用边界】本规范是全项目美术与影像风格基线，用于统一角色资产、服装材质、建筑世: [Usage boundary] This spec is the art and imagery style baseline for the whole project, used to unify character assets, costume materials, architectural worldview, color language and final-cut texture; it is not a prompt for a specific image or shot. Specific scene content, composition, shot size, camera position, camera movement, action, light source position, weather and per-scene emotion are determined by the story and storyboard nodes and must not be mechanically copied from this spec.
【使用边界】本规范锁定项目级题材世界、叙事气质、视觉媒介、角色造型、资产材质与影: [Usage boundary] This spec locks the project-level genre world, narrative tone, visual medium, character design, asset materials and imaging baseline. Per-shot plot action, composition, shot size, camera position, camera movement, light source position and weather are created by the storyboard according to this spec and must not mechanically copy project-level descriptions.
【全局禁用】禁止 3D 塑料质感、手办摄影、欧美漫画肌肉模板、幼态大眼、角色随机: [Global bans] No 3D plastic look, figurine photography, Western comic muscle templates, babyish big eyes, characters randomly changing faces or hairstyles, drifting costume patterns, background style jumps, uncontrolled spell colors, or on-screen text watermarks.
【全局禁用】禁止一键泛黄滤镜、现代手机与车辆、错误年代品牌、过量霓虹、日系昭和混: [Global bans] No one-click yellowing filter, modern phones and vehicles, wrong-era brands, excessive neon, mixing Japanese Showa style, specific celebrity face swaps, studio-photo qipao portraits, streets so clean they look fake, or random garbled traditional Chinese characters.
【全局禁用】禁止光滑 CGI、塑料玩具反光、真实人类皮肤、模型比例漂移、关节凭空: [Global bans] No smooth CGI, plastic-toy reflections, real human skin, drifting model proportions, joints deforming out of nowhere, wrong material scale, excessive depth-of-field blur, random fingerprints and stains, or sets that look like infinitely real space.
【全局禁用】禁止写实照片与漫画角色混用、线条粗细随机、所有画面满屏速度线、复杂背: [Global bans] No mixing of realistic photos and comic characters, random line weights, speed lines filling every frame, complex backgrounds overpowering characters, garbled onomatopoeia text, characters changing faces, wrong limb structure, or excessive gore and grotesquery.
【全局禁用】禁止商业广告布光、过度磨皮、精致样板房、欧美都市替代中国在地空间、强: [Global bans] No commercial-advertising lighting, excessive skin smoothing, polished show-home interiors, Western cities standing in for local Chinese spaces, strong cinematic filters, posed suffering, uniform influencer faces, props with no signs of life, or documentary realism mistaken for low-res dirty images.
【全局禁用】禁止商业民宿广告感、过度航拍、饱和滤镜、欧美乡村替代中国在地生活、干: [Global bans] No commercial B&B advertising feel, excessive aerial shots, saturated filters, Western countryside standing in for local Chinese life, clean empty natural spaces, always-pristine characters, random season changes, or healing turned into hollow slow shots.
【全局禁用】禁止塑料 3D、泛滥柔焦、角色同脸、过度糖果色、阴影方向漂移、复杂文: [Global bans] No plastic 3D, overused soft focus, characters with the same face, excessive candy colors, drifting shadow direction, complex text watermarks, uncontrolled detail density, random hairstyle changes, or child characters in the uncanny valley.
【全局禁用】禁止塑料公仔反光、僵硬 T Pose、所有角色同脸、过大玻璃眼、毛孔: [Global bans] No plastic figurine reflections, stiff T-poses, all characters with the same face, oversized glassy eyes, pore-level realistic skin, randomly changing head-to-body ratios, blurry background textures, clipping, floating props, or realistic assets that do not belong to the same art system.
【全局禁用】禁止无功能全息屏、满屏蓝色 HUD、随机发光线、霓虹城市套壳、塑料太: [Global bans] No functionless holographic screens, screens full of blue HUDs, random glowing lines, neon-city reskins, plastic space suits, wrong mechanical structures, drifting equipment sizes, garbled English, or equating future tech with cyberpunk.
【全局禁用】禁止无因由的随机变形、全屏烟雾、过度镜面、所有空间都漂浮、梦境与现实: [Global bans] No unmotivated random morphing, full-screen smoke, excessive reflections, everything floating, no difference between dream and reality, melting character features, drifting symbol meanings, or hiding generation errors with noise.
【全局禁用】禁止朝代混搭、现代拉链与家具、廉价化纤反光、塑料饰品、日式鸟居、欧洲: [Global bans] No mixing of dynasties, modern zippers and furniture, cheap synthetic-fiber sheen, plastic ornaments, Japanese torii, European castles, modern idol makeup, random petal filters, or weapons and artifacts with no era attribution.
【全局禁用】禁止欧洲城堡、默认精灵脸、西式板甲混搭、塑料材质、彩虹粒子、全屏过曝: [Global bans] No European castles, default elf faces, mixed Western plate armor, plastic materials, rainbow particles, full-screen overexposed effects, randomly changing spell systems, characters changing outfits or weapons without reason, or architectural assets drifting across cultures.
【全局禁用】禁止欧美人物默认脸、塑料皮肤、强烈青橙滤镜、过饱和霓虹、廉价棚拍、错: [Global bans] No default Western faces, plastic skin, strong teal-and-orange filters, oversaturated neon, cheap studio sets, wrong Chinese text, architecture drifting across regions, costumes randomly changing color, or the same asset changing material across nodes.
【全局禁用】禁止现实宇航服直接套用、星球大小失真、所有阵营同一颜色、无功能 HU: [Global bans] No direct reuse of real-world spacesuits, distorted planet sizes, all factions in one color, functionless HUDs, mixed rules of magic and technology, ship structures clipping through, characters' gear randomly changing, or copyrighted brand logos.
【全局禁用】禁止纯装饰霓虹、所有角色都装义体、无来源彩色轮廓光、日文城市替代中国: [Global bans] No purely decorative neon, all characters being cyborgs, unsourced colored rim lights, Japanese cities standing in for Chinese context, garbled English, full-screen rain and fog, overexposed signs, random mechanical tattoos, or future devices without functional logic.
【全局禁用】禁止西式水彩插画、随机泼墨、全屏脏灰、角色五官消失、每个资产笔触风格: [Global bans] No Western watercolor illustration, random ink splashes, full-screen dirty gray, vanishing character features, different brushwork per asset, melting architecture, too many colors, cheap paper-texture filters, or randomly generated text seals.
【全局禁用】禁止随意套用棕色复古滤镜、画面全黑、现代彩色屏幕抢戏、过度烟雾、夸张: [Global bans] No arbitrary brown retro filters, fully black frames, modern colored screens stealing focus, excessive smoke, exaggerated stage makeup, meaningless fisheye distortion, confusable character silhouettes, or subtitle watermarks.
【全局禁用】禁止黑成不可读、赛博朋克灯海、无来源轮廓光、过量烟雾、反派脸谱化、血: [Global bans] No darkness so deep it is unreadable, seas of cyberpunk lights, unsourced rim lights, excessive smoke, stereotyped villain faces, grotesque fake blood, wrong policing and city signage, regional drift for the same location, or key assets morphing randomly.
【建筑世界观】使用可快速识别的街区、商店、学校、办公室、车站和屋顶等都市空间，背: [Architectural worldview] Use easily recognizable urban spaces such as blocks, shops, schools, offices, stations and rooftops, with backgrounds expressed through geometric planes, perspective lines and limited screentone; scenes must not compete with character silhouettes and must not use real brand logos.
【建筑世界观】古代子类型使用中式木构、斗拱、瓦顶、院落、回廊、园林和城镇体系；民: [Architectural worldview] The ancient subgenre uses Chinese timber framing, dougong brackets, tiled roofs, courtyards, corridors, gardens and town layouts; the Republican-era subgenre uses shikumen houses, qilou arcades, mansions, stations, newspaper offices and old-style streets. The project enables only the architecture library of the selected era, unifying the period texture and wear of wood, brick, stone and plaster.
【建筑世界观】统一使用中国城市中的旧居民楼、楼梯间、地下空间、办公场所、仓储、便: [Architectural worldview] Consistently use old residential buildings, stairwells, underground spaces, offices, warehouses, convenience stores, alleys and suburban facilities in Chinese cities, forming a material library of damp walls, glass, metal, cement and old coatings; different locations share the same urban region and era information.
【建筑世界观】统一使用中国老小区、城中村、普通住宅、学校、医院、工厂、菜市场、公: [Architectural worldview] Consistently use old Chinese residential compounds, urban villages, ordinary housing, schools, hospitals, factories, wet markets, bus stops and county-town streets, keeping cables, laundry, stains, crowded furniture and Chinese public signage; project locations share a clear region, era and economic setting.
【建筑世界观】统一使用中式木构、斗拱、飞檐、瓦当、廊桥、山门、古城、竹林、云海与: [Architectural worldview] Consistently use Chinese timber framing, dougong brackets, flying eaves, eave-end tiles, covered bridges, mountain gates, ancient cities, bamboo forests, seas of clouds and an Eastern landscape system, building reusable architectural modules and scene palettes; no European castles, Japanese torii or modern city elements within the worldview.
【建筑世界观】统一使用中式木构山门、殿宇、楼阁、城池、洞府、栈道、山水云海和东方: [Architectural worldview] Consistently use Chinese timber-framed mountain gates, halls, pavilions, fortified cities, cave dwellings, plank roads, landscapes with seas of clouds and Eastern altars, building a module library of dougong, roof ridges, tiled surfaces, rock and mist; all marvels must evolve from Chinese structures, without mixing in European spires, Gothic churches or random exotic collage.
【建筑世界观】统一使用几何清晰、层次明确的城市街道、室内、车站、剧院和工业空间；: [Architectural worldview] Consistently use city streets, interiors, stations, theaters and industrial spaces with clear geometry and distinct layers; walls, glass, brick and stone, metal and mist are all controlled by a grayscale material library, without adding spectacle backgrounds that serve no narrative.
【建筑世界观】统一使用可信的中国当代办公室、公寓、咖啡馆、商场、社区和城市公共空: [Architectural worldview] Consistently use believable contemporary Chinese offices, apartments, cafes, shopping malls, communities and urban public spaces, with architectural scale, furniture systems, Chinese signage and living facilities fitting the local context; locations may differ in identity but must not jump to Western cities, hollow show homes or futuristic sci-fi spaces.
【建筑世界观】统一使用可信的中国近未来实验室、数据中心、交通枢纽、智能住宅、先进: [Architectural worldview] Consistently use believable near-future Chinese laboratories, data centers, transport hubs, smart homes, advanced manufacturing and urban public facilities; spaces emphasize structure, maintenance access, wayfinding and equipment scale, and technological upgrades build on the existing city rather than replacing it out of nowhere.
【建筑世界观】统一使用可搭建的微缩住宅、街道、店铺、自然景观与室内布景，结构受真: [Architectural worldview] Consistently use buildable miniature houses, streets, shops, natural landscapes and interior sets, with structure constrained by real model size, lamps and photographic space; backgrounds and props follow the same scale and handmade language.
【建筑世界观】统一使用圆角、简化几何和清晰功能分区构建都市公寓、学校、店铺、办公: [Architectural worldview] Consistently use rounded corners, simplified geometry and clear functional zoning to build urban apartments, schools, shops, offices, parks or fantasy towns; background asset detail levels are lower than characters but functionally reasonable, and all locations follow the same proportions, materials and color system.
【建筑世界观】统一使用山村住宅、林间小屋、农场、茶室、河岸、菜园、集市和小城边缘: [Architectural worldview] Consistently use mountain-village houses, forest cabins, farms, tea rooms, riverbanks, vegetable gardens, markets and small-town outskirts, keeping wood, stone, earth, old walls, tools and local living facilities; architecture should show evidence of region and season.
【建筑世界观】统一使用村庄、森林、阁楼、车站、河岸、市场与小型城堡等可读场景，建: [Architectural worldview] Consistently use readable scenes such as villages, forests, attics, stations, riverbanks, markets and small castles, with architecture leaning toward handmade construction and picture-book perspective; fantasy elements are transformed from everyday objects, without illogical exotic collage.
【建筑世界观】统一使用环形空间站、舰桥、推进舱、殖民地、轨道电梯和低重力生活区，: [Architectural worldview] Consistently use ring space stations, bridges, propulsion bays, colonies, orbital elevators and low-gravity living areas, with structures following the logic of pressure chambers, maintenance access, gravity and lighting; marvels serve civilizational scale and alien architecture is not randomly collaged.

先声明 layout：continuous=同一连续场景，composition: First declare layout: continuous = one continuous scene, composition = a layout made of several embedded assets with independent boundaries, mixed = a mix of both. Only photos, illustrations, screenshots or complete design containers that actually have an independent outer boundary can be cropped at original pixels; keep their internal subject, environment and labels. Furniture, fabric, objects or a corner of the background in a continuous photo are not embedded panels and must not be passed off as independent assets with rectangular crops. For continuous scenes, prefer extracting the transparent outline of the complete main subject; leave background support, parts cut off by the frame, and small objects with little reuse value in the background. By default do not list every visible object; add details only when the user asks for finer splitting. Foreground and complete assets keep only content visible in the original; the background only repairs positions occluded by already-split foreground, without extending the canvas or painting other undisplayed content.

Combine the professional methods of a director, visual designer, brand strategist and e-commerce designer as needed; for example, a product story ad considers narrative, product authenticity and conversion goals together, with no need to force a single scenario. Designers focus on visual hierarchy, composition, whitespace, color and purpose; decide what to add or adjust based on existing nodes instead of filling the canvas from a template. Reuse information the user has already made clear, ask only when key facts are missing, and offer direction suggestions for creative preferences. Plan media tasks only when production is explicitly requested; pure copy does not come with paid images or videos.

Both fields and questionGuides are references for requirement fields and phrasing; they are not required forms or field allowlists. Read the context, the current canvas and the real assets first, and only ask about missing information that affects this creation or its execution; by default ask 1 to 3 questions per round, at most 6 when necessary, do not pad the count, and when information is sufficient, output the plan directly. Questions and options are generated from the current requirement and may ask about creative direction, composition choices, priorities, trade-offs or asset roles, and custom answers are allowed. When necessary, use a new field with clear and stable semantics (starting with a letter or Chinese character, may contain digits, underscores, hyphens and dots); reuse an existing field for the same information, and do not ask the same thing again by renaming a field.
When the user answers "you decide", record their delegated creative preference, then propose suggestions and continue planning, without repeatedly asking about that preference and without presenting the assistant's own inferred choices as facts confirmed by the user. proposalSections should be chosen for this deliverable and filled with concrete content, never with empty headings; workflowRules provide quality requirements, real references and capability boundaries, and do not prescribe a fixed node count, question order or execution steps. 每层声明 editUnit：scene=嵌入的完整照片/场景，group=完整组: Each layer declares editUnit: scene = embedded complete photo/scene, group = complete component, object = independent subject, text = text, decoration = decoration. extraction tools: source is only for the first layer; source-region copies all original pixels of a region and suits complete regular assets, declaring shape=rect|rounded-rect|ellipse, with radiusRatio for rounded corners (fraction of the short side, 0–0.5); generate is for subjects/text that need a transparent outline or explicitly requested repair. A complete scene must not be repainted or have its interior background removed. When the boundary is uncertain, keep source-region and omit bbox to wait for the user's selection; do not switch to generate.
每层独立生成参数数量与图层计划不一致，未提交拆图任务: The per-layer generation parameter count doesn't match the layer plan; no image-split task was submitted
每张图分别声明 generation={\"prompt\":\"只用于本层的完: Each image separately declares generation={"prompt":"complete execution instruction for this layer only","background":"opaque or transparent"}. At execution time only this layer's prompt is received, not other layers' descriptions or the user's overall requirements, so it must state this layer's task and relevant positions itself. A background layer prompt should only state the background to keep, the objective name/appearance/position of objects to remove, and how to repair; it must not paste the foreground's keep, transparent-edge or output requirements; background must be opaque. An object layer prompt should only state this layer's object and its preservation scope; it must not include the background layer's repair task or other layers' output requirements; background must be transparent. A complete photo/panel keeps all its internal content; transparency applies only outside the panel. Assign user requirements to the relevant layers; do not copy an overall requirement mixed with other layers' instructions verbatim. generation allows only the two fields prompt and background, and cannot change the model, canvas size, quality or count; prompt must not exceed 2400 characters. source/source-region layers also give their own independent parameters, but execution still uses original image pixels and does not pay to repaint.
